# @ndigo/dom

Ndigo DOM – Isomorphic DOM parsing integration layer

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Public exports

- `DOMProvider` *(type)* — Provides an isomorphic abstraction over DOM parsing and element creation.
- `BrowserDOMProvider` — A `DOMProvider` backed by the native browser DOM APIs. Requires a browser environment with `DOMParser` and `document` available.
- `LinkedomDOMProvider` — A `DOMProvider` backed by linkedom for server-side or isomorphic DOM operations without a real browser environment.
- `createDOMProvider` — Creates an appropriate `DOMProvider` based on the current runtime environment. Returns a `BrowserDOMProvider` when a browser DOM is available, or a `LinkedomDO…
